about.title: About DappleByte

about.whatBody: DappleByte is an independent studio building Android apps. One developer, a small number of apps, each one meant to do a specific job well and then stay out of the way.
about.openSourceBody: Where an app's source code is published, the link is on that app's page and in its press kit. Relaypad is published under the AGPL-3.0.

sitePrivacy.title: Website privacy
sitePrivacy.description: dapplebyte.com sets no cookies, runs no analytics and loads no third-party scripts.
items: This website is static HTML. It sets no cookies and loads no third-party scripts, fonts or analytics.
We do not run analytics here. Our only numbers come from Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, which report search impressions in aggregate.
If you email us, we keep the message as long as needed to help you, then delete it. We do not add you to any list.
The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, which logs requests the way any web server does. See GitHub's privacy statement for details.
Each app has its own privacy policy, linked from its page. Those policies cover what the apps do; this page only covers the website.

a01-tutorial.title: How to create a key mapping, step by step
a01-tutorial.description: Pick a game, add a button, press the controller button you want to use, drag it onto the spot on screen, then save and play.

a01-ad.title: Play touch-only games with your controller
a01-ad.description: A short look at Gamepad Pro turning a controller's buttons, sticks and triggers into touch controls in a game that only supports touch.

a02-ad.title: One button. Five different things
a02-ad.description: One controller button can be a tap, a hold, a swipe, a turbo or a macro that taps several spots in order; this shows how to choose in the editor.

t01.title: Map the analog sticks and L2/R2
t01.description: Both sticks and both triggers are already in every new layout: drag them into place, then tap one to choose camera swipe or movement dial and set its sensitivity.

t02.title: Button in the wrong spot? Fix it without leaving the game
t02.description: Tap the floating button during a game to show your layout on top of it, drag the button to the right spot and apply it without leaving the game.

p01.title: Only one button works at a time?
p01.description: When a second touch gets dropped, update to the latest version first, then follow the steps in Settings › Advanced multi-touch.

p02.title: Your controller isn't detected?
p02.description: Check the Bluetooth or USB connection and the pairing in Android settings, reconnect the controller and make sure it is in the right mode.

p03.title: Buttons work but the sticks do nothing?
p03.description: Why analog sticks and triggers need the Gamepad Pro keyboard on some Android versions, and how to turn it on so they can be mapped.

p04.title: Mapping worked, then just stopped?
p04.description: Android can close apps in the background to save power; turning off battery optimisation for Gamepad Pro keeps your mappings running.

p05.title: Why does it need the Accessibility permission?
p05.description: What the Accessibility service is used for: turning your button presses into taps and swipes, without reading or uploading what is on your screen.

p06.title: Screen stopped responding to your fingers?
p06.description: How to pause every mapping at once, from the switch on the home screen or from Quick Settings when you can't get back to the app.

p07.title: Keyboard took over — how do I type now?
p07.description: Tap the globe to switch back to your own keyboard, or turn on automatic switching so Gamepad Pro only uses its keyboard while mappings run.

heroPoints: Buttons, sticks and L2/R2 triggers become taps, holds and swipes
A layout for every game, and Phases for different parts of it
Macros, turbo and button combos. No root, no cloning
gamepad-pro.faqDescription: Answers about Gamepad Pro: setup and permissions, building a key mapping, sticks and triggers, controllers, Pro and backups.
gamepad-pro.faqNotFoundBody: Write to us with your phone model, your controller, the game and what happened. A person reads every message.

beforeItems: Open the FAQ. Most setup, permission and mapping questions are answered there, with the same wording as in the app.
Check that the Accessibility service is on and that mapping isn't paused. If it worked before and then stopped, battery optimisation is the usual cause; the FAQ has the steps.
Note which game, which controller and what happens on screen when you press a button. That is what we need to reproduce it.
support.refundBody: Gamepad Pro is free to install. If you bought Pro and it doesn't work with your setup, email us within 7 days of the purchase and we'll refund it. Tell us what you tried; it helps us fix it for the next person.

press.description: Facts, assets and a boilerplate for writing about Gamepad Pro, the controller key mapper for Android.
press.boilerplate: Gamepad Pro turns the controller you already own into touch controls for Android games that don't support gamepads: buttons, sticks and triggers become taps, holds and swipes, with a layout per game, Phases, macros, turbo and button combos. No root is required. It is made by DappleByte, an independent studio.
press.priceValue: Free to install, with ads. A one-time Pro purchase removes the ads and unlocks every Pro feature; there is no subscription. The current price is shown on Google Play.

beforeItems: Open the FAQ. Most connection, sign-in and picture questions are answered there, with the same wording as in the app.
If the app can't connect, run Connection Doctor from Settings. It checks your network, the console and Remote Play, and it can email the report to us with one tap.
Make sure the console is on or in rest mode with Remote Play turned on in its settings.
